new.analysis:
During week 38 the athlete is in the recovery phase, aiming to increase walking‑run time by about 10% while keeping shin pain low. The plan repeats the familiar three walk‑run days (Mon, Wed, Sat) at 1.8 km, with the same walking‑interval pattern, to keep running minutes up but still within safe limits. Rest days on Tue, Thu, Fri, and Sun allow recovery and physio work.

The plan is conservative: no hard zones, no hills, and no volume jump beyond 10 %.

The only new element is the 1.8 km target (slightly longer than the 1.7 km from last week) which is consistent with the goal of 30 min run by mid‑October.

All data suggest the athlete’s shin is still quiet, RPE remains 3/10 and HR stays in zone 1‑2, so a mild increment is acceptable.
